question: how many credits is the psychology minor and which classes are required for it

body.answer:
The Psychology Minor (Minor) requires 16–24 credits [2]. The catalog lists PSYC 101 INTRODUCTION TO PSYCHOLOGY as required, plus three psychology courses—one from each of three different categories—and one additional psychology course [1]. The category choices are: Social and Organizational: PSYC 226 SOCIAL PSYCHOLOGY or PSYC 345 WORKPLACE PSYCHOLOGY; Cognition and Perception: PSYC 202 PSYCHOLOGY OF LEARNING, PSYC 209 PSYCHOLOGY OF PERCEPTION, or PSYC 227 COGNITIVE PSYCHOLOGY; Development: PSYC 212 PSYCHOLOGY OF AGING, PSYC 241 DEVELOPMENTAL PSYCHOLOGY, PSYC 263 CHILD PSYCHOLOGY, or PSYC 347 ADOLESCENT PSYCHOLOGY; Socio-Cultural Perspectives: PSYC 231 MULTICULTURAL PSYCHOLOGY, PSYC 239 CROSS-CULTURAL PSYCHOLOGY, PSYC 311 PSYCHOLOGY OF GENDER, PSYC 335 SEXUALITIES AND GENDER IDENTITIES: LGBTQA+, PSYC 307 PSYCHOLOGY OF YOGA, or PSYC 349 PSYCHOLOGY OF WOMEN; Clinical Perspectives: PSYC 314 PSYCHOPATHOLOGY, PSYC 321 THEORIES OF PERSONALITY, or PSYC 357 CHILDHOOD DISORDERS; Brain and Behavior: PSYC 310 NEUROPSYCHOLOGY, PSYC 352 BEHAVIORAL NEUROSCIENCE, PSYC 353 COGNITIVE NEUROSCIENCE, or PSYC 355 NEUROPSYCHOPHARMACOLOGY; Fieldwork/Independent Research: PSYC 319 ADULT PSYCHOLOGY FIELDWORK, PSYC 320 PSYCHOPATHOLOGY FIELDWORK, PSYC 339 FIELDWORK WITH ADOLESCENTS, PSYC 357 CHILDHOOD DISORDERS, PSYC 367 FIELDWORK WITH CHILDREN, PSYC 368 FIELDWORK IN FORENSIC PSYCHOLOGY, or PSYC 472 ADVANCED RESEARCH. Choose the additional course from the catalog’s listed psychology-course options [1]. A Psychology BA is also offered [1].

question: thinking about double majoring in communication and english. what does each major require and do any of the classes overlap

body.answer:
The catalog lists Communication Arts BA and English & Literary Studies BA majors. [2]

Communication Arts BA (Bachelor of Arts) has two concentrations: Digital Journalism and Writing, or Global Communication and Media. Both require COMM 204 and 221; one or more 300-level history/theory/criticism courses; a capstone (one); CNTP 388; and PATH 001, 002, 003. Digital Journalism and Writing also requires COMM 231; one of COMM 203/227/234; COMM 208, 303, 324, and one of COMM 226/311/319; two digital storytelling courses; one digital tools course; and one specialized writing course. Global Communication and Media requires COMM 203, 232, 267; one 300-level course; COMM 234, 266, 318; one production course; two criticism/analysis courses; two writing courses; and one elective. Selectable courses are listed at https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/AH-BA-COMM. [1]

I don’t have verified English & Literary Studies requirements or enough information to identify class overlap. For double majors, no more than half the courses may count toward both, and all writing-intensive courses required for the second major must be completed. [6]

Contact the School of Arts, Humanities, and Education Office about English requirements or specific course overlap: AHEOffice@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7365, B-224. [1]

question: what does intro to anthropology cover and how many credits is it

body.answer:
ANTH 102 Introduction to Anthropology is 4 credits. It examines human diversity and how culture shapes human adaptations and actions. The course introduces anthropology’s methods, theories, and basic concepts; uses cultural relativism and case studies from around the world to explore cultural differences and question assumptions about what is “natural”; and addresses how anthropology can help us understand contemporary problems such as social and economic inequality. It has no published prerequisites and carries the Gen Ed 18-Global Awareness (GEGA) attribute. [2]

Sources: [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/ANTH102)

question: should i do a second major or just a minor if i want to go to grad school for public policy

body.answer:
Ramapo’s pages don’t say whether a second major or a minor is better preparation for public-policy graduate school, so I can’t make that recommendation. The Center for Student Success suggests “Consider double majoring, or having a major and a minor,” and advises getting co-op or internship experience before graduating [11].

Ramapo’s undergraduate-degree page says students may pursue a minor and/or a second major [3]. A minor must include 16–24 credits; courses for your primary or secondary major can overlap with the minor, but no more than half of its credits [5].

Ramapo lists a Public Policy Master of Public Policy (MPP); its description says the program trains students in research methodologies, quantitative and qualitative methods, and skills for work with or for public institutions [1]. Public Policy 4+1 and Public Policy Minor are also listed [1].

For help weighing your options, contact the Center for Student Success (Academic Advising): success@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7441, D-207 [11].

question: Could you explain what the general education requirements are at Ramapo? I'd like to know which categories my son has to complete and roughly how many credits they add up to.

body.answer:
Ramapo’s General Education curriculum is ten courses: four keystone courses, four keystone-category courses, and courses in two of the three distribution categories [8]. The four keystone courses are First Year Seminar, Social Science Inquiry, Critical Reading & Writing 102, and Studies in the Arts & Humanities. Critical Reading & Writing 102 must be taken within the first 64 credits [8]. The four keystone categories are Global Awareness, Historical Perspectives, Scientific Reasoning, and Quantitative Reasoning; Quantitative Reasoning must also be completed within the first 64 credits [8]. All students must complete reading, writing, and mathematics requirements by 64 credits [10, 11].

For distribution categories, the Provost page lists Culture & Creativity, Systems, Sustainability, & Society, and Values & Ethics, and says at least one course must be offered by a school other than the one housing the student’s major [8]. Another page, for changes taking effect Fall 2026, lists Culture and Creativity, Values and Ethics, and Social Systems and Society, and says the “out of school requirement” is no longer enforced in degree audit tools; the pages differ [9].

question: My son wants to major in computer science. What are the prerequisites for CMPS 147, and does he need to take a math placement test before he can register for it?

body.answer:
CMPS 147 is a required course in the Computer Science BS. [1] It is 4 credits.
